name: Hubertusheim
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Hubertusheim is located in the upper part of the Leutaschtal valley in a quiet valley position. The holiday apartment is functionally furnished and offers guests simple accommodation for stays in the region. From the house, hiking trails in the Olympiaregion Seefeld are easily accessible. In about ten minutes, you can reach the center of Leutasch with shopping opportunities. Parkplätze are available on the property.
